info.name: sn-test API
info.description: Full automated check of the sn-test API against the running `docker compose` stack (needs the mailpit service and STORAGE_DRIVER=local). Creates two users per run (pm_alice_<runId>, pm_bob_<runId>), reads their confirmation emails from Mailpit, and walks auth, posts with real files, comments, likes, follows, profiles, search and deletion. Run the whole collection in order (Collection Runner or `npm run test:postman`); wait a minute between runs because of the rate limits. See postman/README.md.
